description: Schema and policy for reports/thumbnail_deferrals.json. Enforced by scripts/verify-thumbs-deferrals.js (npm run verify:thumbs-deferrals). Add or renew entries only via scripts/defer-thumbnail.js. See docs/THUMBNAIL_DEFERRALS.md.
legacyReasonNote: The pre-contract file spelled the reason with a space. The gate rejects it; defer-thumbnail.js normalizes it on write.

gpuCapturePending.windowNote: expires - deferred_at must be 1..maxWindowDays days. deferred_at is the date of the latest (re)write and may not be in the future.
gpuCapturePending.renewalNote: renewals counts how many times the entry has been renewed. Renewal number 1 needs no evidence. Every renewal beyond maxRenewalsWithoutEvidence needs a capture_failure note (min length, and a run URL or ISO date) describing a real capture attempt that failed.
gpuCapturePending.expired: An entry whose expires date is before today fails the gate. Renew it with defer-thumbnail.js or land a real thumbnail.

pendingRatchetNote: Maximum allowed count of gpu-capture-pending entries. May only decrease: the gate fails if the count exceeds it, and (with --base-ref) if it is higher than the base branch's value. Lower it with `node scripts/defer-thumbnail.js --lower-ratchet` after removing entries.

permanentSkips.note: Permanent skips are NOT deferrals. An id listed in the skip allowlist may not also be deferred.
